Battle.Actions.Texts.SOL.CHECK:
* Sol[wait:0.5] - φ ATK φ DEF[wait:0.5]
* It is SoulEngine's first
  mascot.

* It looks like the framework
  of a regular dodecahedron.
Battle.Actions.Texts.SOL.TALK:
* You tried speaking to Sol...
* It gives a slight nod[wait:0.5]
  as if processing your words.
Battle.Actions.Texts.SOL.STARE:
* You stare at Sol as if trying
  to uncover its secrets...

[noskip]* It completes one full
  rotation, and grows just
  a tiny bit!
Battle.Actions.Texts.SOL.IGNORE:
* You ignored Sol.
* Sol looks a bit deflated.

* The frame of the regular
  dodecahedron has shrunk!
Battle.Actions.Texts.SINCERA.CHECK:
* Sincera[wait:0.5] - 100 ATK 100 DEF[wait:0.5]
* Just a mirror.
Battle.Actions.Texts.SINCERA.APPRECIATE1:
* You stare at Sincera...
* Feeling a bit puzzled.
Battle.Actions.Texts.SINCERA.APPRECIATE2:
* You smile at Sincera, and
  Sincera smiles back at you.
Battle.Actions.Texts.SPIDER.CHECK:
* Spyder?[wait:0.5] - 1 ATK 0 DEF[wait:0.5]
* A spider from ancient days.

* This one is already a year
  old.
Battle.Actions.Texts.SPIDER.TALK:
* You try to move closer to the
  spider and speak to it...

* Oh, I forgot to ask whether
  you're afraid of spiders.[func:Jser]
Battle.Actions.Texts.SPIDER.KNOT:
* You tied a bow around the
  spider's silk thread...

* Well, it tightened back into
  a single line...

* Looks like this silk
  thread gave up halfway.
